details: This package ships no functional UI code despite its name and description; its only executable content is an install-time beacon. package.json declares a preinstall hook ("node index.js"), so the beacon runs automatically on npm install: index.js issues an HTTPS GET to hxxps://realwbx[.]com/ip[.]php?ip=8[.]8[.]8[.]8, sending a hardcoded per-package Authorization token in the request headers, and logs the server response. The same install-time callback to the same host, each with a different hardcoded token, is shipped by other packages in the same campaign, including @mntv-analysis/ui@99.1.1 and web-pixels-manager@76.2.4. The package reads no environment variables, credentials or files, and transmits none; the request carries only a fixed IP literal and the package-specific token. The callback host is not part of the npm registry or any documented service used by the package.
